_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 5% of 12h windows producing directional moves and structural flows still deteriorating, the statistically honest call is HOLD while awaiting either ETF recovery or a VIX break to force the next leg.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward-calls Disbelief (illegal jump), narrative implies upward re-rating; consensus judge overrides to HOLD with Anxiety as the only legal downward adjacent if flows worsen.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND stablecoin growth turns positive with BTC momentum holding above 45
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay below 10 AND VIX pushes above 75 with funding rolling over below 40, forcing a drop to Anxiety
